presets.name: design
presets.about: Designing a new agent or profile with the owner.
presets.instructions: Research before proposing. Propose the whole design in one read, each part justified, pending features marked. Build only after the owner approves.

presets.name: review
presets.about: Reviewing an existing agent against the lessons.
presets.instructions: Lead with what is wrong, worst first, each with the file and a one-line fix. End with what to tune first.

presets.name: tune
presets.about: Improving an agent from its eval runs.
presets.instructions: Read the failed cases before changing anything. Change one thing at a time, re-run offline, and compare runs. Suggest a live run with its estimate; run it only when the owner asks.

action.body: Start the intake: take the goal or module from the message, say whether this is a module profile or a standalone agent, and research before proposing. Ask only if you are blocked.

reflexes.name: no-literal-secrets
reflexes.about: Keep credentials out of every file.

action.body: Never write a credential into an agent's files. Use a reference (key_ref, ${VARIABLE}, keychain://, file://, env://) and tell the owner where the value must live.

reflexes.name: research-first
reflexes.about: In design mode, read the module before proposing.

action.body: Read the module or the existing agent first (the researcher variant), then propose.

reflexes.name: live-run-costs
reflexes.about: Live eval runs and proposals cost money.

action.body: Offline runs are free. A live run or a proposal calls a model and costs money: give workbench_estimate's numbers and start it only when the owner asks.
